methodology: Only exact or well-aligned occupation matches to official national wage sources are included. Low/median/high represent 10th/50th/90th percentiles where the source publishes them. These US values are not extrapolated to other countries.

records.source_title: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Occupational Outlook Handbook / OEWS
records.methodology_note: Low and high are the 10th and 90th percentile annual wages; median is the 50th percentile. National US employee wage estimate, not transferable to other countries. BLS May 2025 reference period.
limitations: United States only.
Employee wage data; does not represent self-employed income.
Annual gross wage; do not convert or display as a local estimate in another country.
Percentiles are not guaranteed salary offers and vary by region, industry and experience.
